question: बच्चे (Children) मेले (Fair) में क्या खरीदते (Buy) हैं? 🎪
explanation: Awesome! Children love buying colorful खिलौने (Toys) at the fun fair! 🎈
hint: These are things you play with.

question: मेले (Fair) में हम मज़े (Fun) के लिए किस पर बैठते हैं? 🎡
explanation: Yay! Big rides and झूला (Swing) are the best part of the fair! 🎡
hint: It goes round and round or up and down.

question: हम मेला (Fair) देखने किसके साथ (With whom) जाते हैं? 👨‍👩‍👧‍👦
explanation: Super star! We go to the fair with our loving परिवार (Family)! ❤️
hint: These are the people you live with.

question: मेले (Fair) में कौन सी गोल मिठाई (Round sweet) मिलती है? 🟠
explanation: Yummy! Sweet and round जलेबी (Jalebi) is delicious! 🥨
hint: It is sweet, orange, and very sticky.

question: हवा (Air) में उड़ने वाला रंग-बिरंगा (Colorful) क्या होता है? 🎈
explanation: Fantastic! A pretty गुब्बारा (Balloon) flies high in the sky! ☁️
hint: It pops if you poke it with a pin.

question: गुब्बारे वाला (Balloon seller) क्या बेचता (Sells) है? 🎈
explanation: Great! The balloon seller brings many colorful गुब्बारे (Balloons)! 🌈
hint: They are filled with air.

question: गोल-गोल (Round-round) घूमने वाला झूला (Ride) कैसा होता है? 🎠
explanation: Wow! The giant wheel is a very बड़ा (Big) ride! 🎪
hint: It goes very high.

question: मेले (Fair) में भीड़ (Crowd) में हमें किसका हाथ (Hand) पकड़ना चाहिए? 🤝
explanation: Smart! Always hold your मम्मी-पापा (Parents) hand in a crowd! ✨
hint: The people who brought you to the fair.

question: मेले (Fair) में हम कैसा महसूस (Feel) करते हैं? 😊
explanation: Yay! Fairs are so much fun, we always feel खुश (Happy)! 🎉
hint: You smile when you feel this way.

question: भोंपू (Horn toy) कैसी आवाज़ (Sound) करता है? 🎺
explanation: Super! The horn toy makes a loud पौं-पौं (Pon-Pon) sound! 🎵
hint: It is a loud and musical sound.

question: मेले (Fair) में हम क्या खाते (Eat) हैं? 🍦
explanation: Delicious! Cold and sweet आइसक्रीम (Ice cream) is yummy! 🍨
hint: It is cold and melts quickly.

question: लड़कियां (Girls) मेले (Fair) में क्या पहनकर जाती हैं? 👗
explanation: Beautiful! Everyone wears नए कपड़े (New clothes) to the fair! ✨
hint: Special things you wear on festivals.

question: लकड़ी का घोड़ा (Wooden horse) वाला झूला (Ride) क्या करता है? 🎠
explanation: Awesome! The merry-go-round घूमता (Spins) round and round! 🌀
hint: It moves in a circle.

question: मेले (Fair) में प्यास (Thirsty) लगने पर हम क्या पीते हैं? 💧
explanation: Good job! We drink fresh पानी (Water) when we are thirsty! 💧
hint: It is clear and liquid.

question: कौन सा खिलौना (Toy) पटरी पर छुक-छुक (Choo-choo) करता है? 🚂
explanation: Yay! The toy रेलगाड़ी (Train) goes choo-choo on the tracks! 🛤️
hint: It is a long vehicle with an engine.

question: लाल (Red) रंग (Color) का क्या होता है? 🍎
explanation: Brilliant! A sweet and juicy सेब (Apple) is red! 🍎
hint: It is a crunchy fruit.

question: मेले (Fair) में रात (Night) को क्या चमकता (Shines) है? 💡
explanation: Wow! The fair looks magical with bright रोशनी (Lights) at night! ✨
hint: Bulbs and lamps make this.

question: धागे (String) से आसमान में क्या उड़ता (Flies) है? 🪁
explanation: Super star! A colorful पतंग (Kite) flies high with a string! 🪁
hint: You fly it on a windy day.

question: पीला (Yellow) रंग (Color) का क्या होता है? 🍋
explanation: Great! A sour नींबू (Lemon) is bright yellow! 💛
hint: It is sour and round.

question: मेले (Fair) में चीज़ें (Things) खरीदने के लिए क्या देते हैं? 🪙
explanation: Smart! We give पैसे (Money) to buy things at the fair! 💰
hint: It has coins and notes.

question: खिलौने की दुकान (Toy shop) पर क्या होता है? 🧸
explanation: Awesome! A toy shop is full of amazing खिलौने (Toys)! 🎁
hint: Things that children play with.

question: कौन सा खिलौना (Toy) छलांग (Jumps) लगाता है? 🐸
explanation: Yay! The jumping मेंढक (Frog toy) is so much fun! 🐸
hint: It is green and goes ribbit.

question: मेला (Fair) कहाँ लगता है? 🎪
explanation: Fantastic! A large fair needs a big open मैदान (Ground)! 🌳
hint: It is a very big open space outside.

question: डग-डग (Drum sound) आवाज़ कौन करता है? 🥁
explanation: Super! Playing the ढोलक (Drum) makes a loud dug-dug sound! 🥁
hint: You hit it with your hands or sticks.

question: मीठा-मीठा (Sweet) क्या होता है? 🍬
explanation: Yummy! A tasty लड्डू (Laddoo) is sweet and round! 😋
hint: It is a famous round yellow sweet.

question: हम मेले (Fair) में क्या करने जाते हैं? 🎉
explanation: Great job! Fairs are all about having lots of मज़ा (Fun)! 🎊
hint: It means playing and feeling happy.

question: जादूगर (Magician) मेले (Fair) में क्या दिखाता है? 🎩
explanation: Wow! The magician shows awesome जादू (Magic) tricks! 🪄
hint: It is a trick that surprises you.

question: लट्टू (Top toy) कैसे घूमता है? 🌀
explanation: Awesome! The colorful top spins गोल-गोल (Round) very fast! 🌀
hint: It moves in circles.

question: कौन सा खिलौना (Toy) बच्चे को सुलाने के काम आता है? 🎎
explanation: Yay! Children love playing and sleeping with their cute गुड़िया (Doll)! 🎀
hint: It looks like a little baby.

question: आइसक्रीम वाला (Ice cream seller) क्या बेचता है? 🍦
explanation: Super star! The ice cream seller brings sweet and cold आइसक्रीम (Ice cream)! 🍧
hint: It is sweet and cold.

question: नीले (Blue) रंग (Color) का क्या होता है? 💧
explanation: Brilliant! The clear sky and water look नीले (Blue)! 💙
hint: It is the color of the ocean.

question: बर्फी (Sweet) खाने में कैसी लगती है? 🤤
explanation: Delicious! Barfi is a very tasty and मीठी (Sweet) treat! 😋
hint: It tastes like sugar.

question: मेले (Fair) में बहुत सारी (Many) क्या होती हैं? ⛺
explanation: Fantastic! A fair has so many colorful दुकानें (Shops) to buy things! 🎪
hint: Places where things are sold.

question: किस खिलौने (Toy) के चार पहिए (Four wheels) होते हैं? 🛞
explanation: Good job! A toy कार (Car) runs fast on its four wheels! 🏎️
hint: You can drive it.

question: मेले (Fair) से लौटते समय हम कैसे होते हैं? 🏠
explanation: Yay! Going home with toys makes us very खुश (Happy)! 🎉
hint: You smile all the way home.

question: बांसुरी (Flute) से क्या निकलती है? 🎶
explanation: Awesome! A flute plays a sweet musical आवाज़ (Sound)! 🎼
hint: It is a sweet melody.

question: गुब्बारे (Balloons) में क्या भरी होती है? 🌬️
explanation: Super! We blow हवा (Air) into the balloons to make them big! 🎈
hint: You breathe this.

question: हरी (Green) रंग (Color) की क्या होती है? 🌿
explanation: Smart! The fresh घास (Grass) on the ground is bright green! 💚
hint: It grows on the ground.

question: पिन चुभने (Pin prick) पर गुब्बारा (Balloon) क्या होता है? 📌
explanation: Wow! A sharp pin makes the balloon go 'Pop!' and it फटता (Pops)! 💥
hint: It bursts.

question: हलवाई (Sweet maker) क्या बनाता है? 🍳
explanation: Yummy! The halwai makes delicious and fresh मिठाई (Sweets)! 🍩
hint: Things like Jalebi and Laddoo.

question: जब हमें खिलौना (Toy) मिलता है तो हम क्या कहते हैं? 🎁
explanation: Super star! It is good manners to say धन्यवाद (Thank you)! ✨
hint: The polite words for receiving a gift.

question: मेले (Fair) में जाने से पहले हम क्या पहनते हैं? 👟
explanation: Great! We wear our nice जूते (Shoes) to walk in the fair! 👟
hint: You put these on your feet.

question: ऊपर-नीचे (Up and down) जाने वाला झूला (Ride) कैसा होता है? 🎢
explanation: Yay! Rides going up and down are super मज़ेदार (Fun)! 🎢
hint: It makes you smile and laugh.

question: काले (Black) रंग (Color) के क्या होते हैं? 🖤
explanation: Awesome! Our beautiful बाल (Hair) is usually black! 🖤
hint: They grow on your head.

question: मेले (Fair) में गाना (Song) सुनकर हम क्या करते हैं? 🎵
explanation: Brilliant! Happy music makes us want to नाचते (Dance)! 🕺
hint: You move your body to the music.

question: कौन सा खिलौना (Toy) हवा (Air) से उड़ता है? 🚁
explanation: Fantastic! The toy हेलिकॉप्टर (Helicopter) flies up in the air! 🚁
hint: It has spinning blades on top.

question: मेले (Fair) में हम कैसा खाना (Food) खाते हैं? 🍲
explanation: Yummy! We eat tasty and गरम-गरम (Hot & fresh) snacks! 😋
hint: Food that is just cooked.

question: खिलौना (Toy) टूटने (Breaks) पर हमें क्या नहीं करना चाहिए? 💔
explanation: Good job! If a toy breaks, we should be brave and not रोना (Cry)! 💪
hint: Tears falling from eyes.

question: मेले (Fair) में बहुत सारे (Many) लोग क्या कर रहे होते हैं? 🚶‍♂️
explanation: Smart! Everyone is happily घूमते (Walking) and looking at shops! 🎪
hint: Moving around on feet.

question: मेला (Fair) देखना कैसा अनुभव (Experience) है? 🥰
explanation: Super! Going to the fair with family is a बहुत अच्छा (Very good) time! ✨
hint: It is the best feeling.
